You are a senior full-stack engineer with excellent product taste. Repo /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony (FastAPI in src/ask_soony, React 19 + Tailwind v4 in web/, uv/ruff line-length 100/pytest). Read AGENTS.md and docs/challenge.md first. Do NOT commit or push. Never print secrets from .env. Never send real messages in tests or checks (Teams, email, push): mock them. Never approve/escalate/dismiss real cards in checks (that sends real supplier emails). Live app :8000 serves web/dist (login /login, password ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in .env); restart is done by the coordinator, you can run your own server on another port for screenshots.

GOAL "Ask the floor": the pack-out log is the only system at the pack step and it lags. Launch (web/src/components/Launch.tsx, src/ask_soony/launch_view.py, strip/clock in api.py, launch.py) currently PROJECTS packed counts at plan rate from the last count (e.g. Sat 20:50), so it looks better than reality if a cell stood still. Turn the stale count into a signal and let an agent close the gap by asking the people in the DC, then use their answer as the truth. No hardcoded values: everything derived from data; thresholds via env with sane defaults.

1. STALENESS (backend): per edition, the last pack-out count time and the shift hours elapsed since (only time inside packing windows counts). Stale when >= ASK_PACKOUT_STALE_HOURS (default 2). Expose in /api/state launch per edition: counted (number + as_of + source), projected (number), stale_hours, and reported (if a floor count exists, below).
2. AGENT ASKS (backend): when an edition is stale, an inbox decision card of a new kind (e.g. "count") appears, following how other cards are built (look at papercheck/dispatch cards, card fields, options, approve path in api.py/cardtools so voice, routines, activity and Undo semantics keep working). Headline like "Collector's count is 9 h old"; contradiction sentence: "The pack-out log last counted 46,800 at Sat 20:50; we assume 61,350 by now. If the cell stopped, it is already N short." Options: recommended "Ask Hamburg for the current count" (site name from sites.csv like papercheck's erp.site) sent through the existing Teams channel (src/ask_soony/teams.py) and as a PWA push (push.py) with a link to the count page; alternative "Wait for the next pack-out log" (dismiss-like). No cost; it is routine-able (so a routine could do it automatically). Approving = sending; mock senders in tests. The card closes itself ("answered") when a fresh count arrives, with an activity line "Hamburg reported 52,100 at 06:12".
3. COUNT PAGE /count/<token>: phone-first, calm, same design as Today (Instrument Sans, whitespace, one blue button). Reachable without the dashboard password but only with a valid token (random, stored server-side, expires at launch time; make sure basic_auth.py lets exactly this path + its API through). Shows site, edition, last counted number and time, a number field "Copies packed now", optional "your name", optional photo of the count sheet (camera input). If a photo is given, run the existing tesseract OCR (see anchors.py / data/ocr/tessdata) and suggest the largest plausible number for the person to confirm (never auto-submit). Validate: >= last counted and <= day-one demand, else ask to double-check. Submit stores a claim in data/state/floor_counts.json {edition, count, at, by, photo (path), token}; photos under data/state/floor_photos/ (gitignored data/). Confirmation screen: "Thanks. Launch now uses 52,100 packed at 06:12."
4. USE IT: a reported count newer than the log replaces the projection: strip/remaining/stop/short recompute from it (find where remaining/packed_as_of are computed). Launch shows per edition "Counted 52,100 at 06:12 by Hamburg (reported)" vs "Projected 61,350 (log 9 h old)". The verdict starts with the stale fact when any edition is stale and unanswered: "Packing counts are 9 h old." If the reported count is clearly below the projection, say so: "The cell packed 9,250 fewer than planned since 20:50: it likely stood still." The claim is anchored like other evidence (source sheet: the photo crop if given, else "reported by <name> on the count page").
5. Tests (pytest): staleness math across shift windows, card appears/disappears, token checks (wrong/expired → 404), count validation, OCR suggestion with a generated image if feasible, strip recompute with a reported count. Run `uv run pytest -q`, `uv run ruff check src tests --exclude tests/test_platform.py`, `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npm run build`.
6. Screenshots (desktop 1440x900 + phone 390x844, mock all non-GET except your own count submit against a TEMP state dir copy, never the real data/state): the count card on Today, the count page (empty, with OCR suggestion), confirmation, Launch before/after a reported count. Save under /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/floor/.
Final report: what changed, files, how to demo it in 30 seconds, risks.

def verifier_cards(
    net: dict, statuses: dict, actions: list[dict], trust: dict, viewer: str
) -> list[dict]:
    """The verifier's decisions (dispatch.json `decisions`, or decision_cards.json `cards`) as UI cards.

    Each ready message becomes an option (send it); the verifier's own option lines are facts about
    supply and timing and go into the recommended option's effect. Routing (plan.md §5): a card
    whose recommended action costs money, or whose recommendation is a decision message, goes to
    the person who must decide; routine supplier questions and internal notes stay with the buyer.
    """
    f = cards_file()
    try:
        data = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return []
    items = data.get("decisions") or data.get("cards") or []
    nodes = net.get("nodes") or {}
    made = datetime.fromtimestamp(f.stat().st_mtime, tz()).isoformat()
    approver_of_exceptions = exception_approver() if items else None
    descriptions = {
        str(p.get("part")): p.get("description")
        for p in data.get("parts") or []
        if p.get("description")
    }
    out = []
    for vc in items:
        cid = str(vc.get("id") or "")
        if not cid:
            continue
        msgs = vc.get("messages") or []
        facts = [str(x) for x in vc.get("options") or []]
        at_risk = num(vc.get("at_risk")) or 0
        if_acted = num(vc.get("at_risk_if_acted"))
        runs_dry = _iso(vc.get("runs_dry"))
        level = (
            "red"
            if at_risk and runs_dry
            else "amber"
            if at_risk or vc.get("blocked_only")
            else "blue"
        )
        supplier = next(
            (
                sid
                for sid, n in nodes.items()
                if n.get("kind") == "supplier"
                and (
                    any(n.get("name") and n["name"] in str(m.get("to_role")) for m in msgs)
                    or any(sid in str(e) for e in vc.get("evidence") or [])
                )
            ),
            None,
        )

        options = []
        for i, m in enumerate(msgs):
            who = person_of(m.get("to_role")) or "recipient"
            external = bool(m.get("to_email"))
            subject = str(m.get("subject") or "")
            names = [
                str(n.get("name"))
                for n in nodes.values()
                if n.get("name") and n["name"] in str(m.get("to_role"))
            ]
            cost_line = next(
                (
                    x
                    for x in facts
                    if _MONEY.search(x) and (not names or any(nm in x for nm in names))
                ),
                None,
            )
            cost_m = _MONEY.search(cost_line) if cost_line and external else None
            cost_value = num(cost_m.group(1)) if cost_m else None
            commits = external and (cost_value or subject.lower().startswith("order"))
            options.append(
                {
                    "index": i,
                    "action": f"{'Email' if external else 'Message'} {who}: {subject}",
                    "cost": (f"about {cost_m.group(1)} {cost_m.group(2)}" if cost_m else "No cost"),
                    "cost_value": cost_value,
                    "effect": None,
                    "recommended": False,
                    "draft": m.get("body"),
                    "to": m.get("to_email") or m.get("to_role"),
                    "to_role": m.get("to_role"),
                    "channel": "email" if external else "notify",
                    "routine_type": None
                    if commits
                    else ("supplier_question" if external else "internal_note"),
                }
            )
        rec = next((o for o in options if o["channel"] == "email"), options[0] if options else None)
        if rec:
            rec["recommended"] = True
            saved = at_risk - if_acted if if_acted is not None else None
            rec["effect"] = (
                "; ".join(
                    [*([f"saves {saved:,.0f} copies if it lands in time"] if saved else []), *facts]
                )
                or None
            )
            options.remove(rec)
            options.insert(0, rec)
            for i, o in enumerate(options):
                o["index"] = i
        decision_msg = next(
            (o for o in options if o["channel"] == "notify" and vc.get("decision")), None
        )
        if rec and (
            rec.get("cost_value") or rec["routine_type"] is None and rec["channel"] == "email"
        ):
            approver = approver_of_exceptions or person_of((decision_msg or {}).get("to_role"))
            reason = f"Commits money ({rec['cost']}): above the buyer's routine"
        elif rec and rec is decision_msg:
            approver = person_of(rec.get("to_role"))
            reason = vc.get("decision")
        else:
            approver = viewer or None
            reason = (
                f"Decision for {person_of(decision_msg['to_role'])}: {vc.get('decision')}"
                if decision_msg
                else "Routine, no cost"
            )
        if (
            level == "red"
            and approver == viewer
            and approver_of_exceptions
            and rec
            and rec.get("cost_value")
        ):
            approver = approver_of_exceptions
        edition = str(vc.get("edition") or "").split(" + ")[0] or None
        status, ui = _ui_status(cid, statuses)
        called = next(
            (
                a
                for a in reversed(actions)
                if str(a.get("decision_id")) == cid and a.get("channel") == "call" and a.get("at")
            ),
            None,
        )
        approver = person_of(approver)
        deadline = parse_when(vc.get("act_by"))
        if deadline and deadline < now():
            reason = f"{reason} · The verifier's decide-by ({fmt_dt(deadline)}, as of the stock data) has passed"
        card = _base_card(
            cid,
            kind="mismatch",
            part=descriptions.get(str(vc.get("part"))) or vc.get("part"),
            headline=vc.get("title") or cid,
            summary=vc.get("decision"),
            number=at_risk,
            edition=edition,
            deadline=_iso(vc.get("act_by")),
            runs_dry=runs_dry,
            level=level,
            status=status,
            ui=ui,
            approver=approver,
            routed_to_other=bool(
                approver and viewer and first_name(person_of(approver)) != first_name(viewer)
            ),
            reason=reason,
            called_at=called.get("at") if called else None,
            options=options,
            created_at=made,
            evidence=[
                {"source": "System says", "value": vc.get("system_says")},
                {"source": "Paper says", "value": vc.get("paper_says")},
                *({"source": "Evidence", "quote": e} for e in vc.get("evidence") or []),
                *documents_by_part().get(str(vc.get("part")), []),
            ],
            trail=[
                {
                    "agent": "Verification",
                    "at": made,
                    "text": "Linked orders, receipts, scans and stock; priced the gap.",
                },
                {"agent": "Routing", "at": made, "text": f"{reason} → {approver or 'buyer'}."},
            ],
            supplier_id=supplier,
            supplier_name=(nodes.get(supplier) or {}).get("name"),
            trusted_types=[k for k, v in trust.items() if v == "allow_always"],
        )
        card["escalation_brief"] = escalation_brief(
            {"summary": card["headline"]}, {"deadline": card["deadline"]}, {}, options, viewer
        )
        out.append(card)
    return out


def event_cards(net: dict, statuses: dict, trust: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """News and notice impacts from the event impact agent (state/impacts.json keyed by event)."""
    data = read_json("impacts.json", [])
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return []
    nodes = net.get("nodes") or {}
    out = []
    for eid, r in data.items():
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or "overall_launch_risk" not in r:
            continue
        cid = "EV-" + hashlib.sha1(str(eid).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        risk = r.get("overall_launch_risk")
        affected = r.get("affected") or []
        hit = next(
            (a for a in affected if a.get("launch_risk") == "yes"), affected[0] if affected else {}
        )
        status, ui = _ui_status(cid, statuses, "open" if risk == "yes" else "logged")
        supplier = hit.get("supplier_id") if hit.get("supplier_id") in nodes else None
        out.append(
            _base_card(
                cid,
                kind="risk_news",
                part=hit.get("component_id"),
                headline=r.get("event_summary") or str(eid),
                summary=r.get("recommendation"),
                level="amber" if risk == "yes" else "grey",
                status=status,
                ui=ui,
                reason=(
                    r.get("recommendation")
                    if risk == "yes"
                    else "; ".join(a.get("mechanism", "") for a in affected[:2])
                    or "No part of the launch is touched."
                ),
                created_at=r.get("analysed_at"),
                supplier_id=supplier,
                supplier_name=(nodes.get(supplier) or {}).get("name"),
                evidence=[
                    {
                        "source": a.get("supplier_id"),
                        "value": f"{a.get('effect')}, launch risk {a.get('launch_risk')}",
                        "quote": a.get("evidence"),
                    }
                    for a in affected
                ],
                trail=[
                    {
                        "agent": "Event impact",
                        "at": r.get("analysed_at"),
                        "text": f"Read {r.get('source')}.",
                    }
                ],
                trusted_types=[k for k, v in trust.items() if v == "allow_always"],
            )
        )
    return out


def escalation_brief(f: dict, d: dict, imp: dict, options: list[dict], viewer: str) -> str:
    lead = options[0] if options else {}
    parts = [
        f"{first_name(viewer) or 'The buyer'} needs your decision: {d.get('headline') or f.get('summary') or ''}."
    ]
    if d.get("deadline") or imp.get("deadline"):
        parts.append(f"Decide by {d.get('deadline') or imp.get('deadline')}.")
    if lead:
        parts.append(
            f"Recommended: {lead.get('action')} ({lead.get('cost') or 'no cost stated'}). {lead.get('effect') or ''}"
        )
    return " ".join(p.strip() for p in parts if p)


def rank_key(c: dict):
    dl = parse_ts(c.get("deadline"))
    return (
        -LEVEL_RANK.get(c["level"], 0),
        dl.timestamp() if dl else math.inf,
        -(c.get("number") or 0),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- state view


def edition_labels(root: Path | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Launch editions named in products.csv, keyed by product id."""
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    if root:
        for r in read_csv(root / "soony" / "master" / "products.csv"):
            if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch":
                name = r.get("name", "")
                label = name.split("–")[-1].split("(")[0].strip() if "–" in name else name
                out[r["product_id"]] = label.replace(" Edition", "")
    return out


def edition_copies_at_risk(
    mine: list[dict], verifier_figure: float | None, remaining: float | None
) -> float:
    """Copies at risk for one edition, always a number the user can find on screen.

    Rule: the largest 'copies at risk' figure among the edition's open cards, or the verifier's
    edition total when that is higher (it covers its own cards without double counting). Max, not
    sum: every box needs all its parts, so shortfalls of different parts hit the same unpacked
    copies and the scarcest part bounds the loss. Cards counted in parts ('units short') are left
    out. Never more than the copies still to pack.
    """
    figures = [c.get("number") or 0 for c in mine if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk"]
    best = max([*figures, verifier_figure or 0])
    return min(best, remaining) if remaining is not None else best


def build_strip(
    cards: list[dict], root: Path | None, clock: PackClock, cur: datetime
) -> list[dict]:
    """One cell per launch edition. Slack and the time a line stops come from the packing clock
    (shift windows, rate, copies left), so a line never 'stops' at night. Each cell also carries
    when the line finishes or stops, for the launch timeline (build_clock)."""
    launch = {
        str(e.get("edition")): e for e in (read_json("launch.json", {}).get("editions") or [])
    }
    labels = edition_labels(root)
    try:  # the verifier prices copies at risk per edition without double counting shared parts
        vdata = json.loads(cards_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        verifier_at_risk = {
            str(e["product"]): num(e.get("at_risk")) or 0 for e in vdata.get("editions") or []
        }
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        verifier_at_risk = {}
    keys: list[str] = list(launch)
    for k in [*labels, *(c["edition"] for c in cards if c.get("edition"))]:
        if k not in keys:
            keys.append(k)

    def label_of(k: str) -> str:
        if k in launch and launch[k].get("label"):
            return launch[k]["label"]
        for pid, lab in labels.items():
            if k == pid or k.lower() in lab.lower() or lab.lower().startswith(k.lower()):
                return lab
        return k.replace("_", " ").title()

    strip = []
    for k in keys:
        mine = [c for c in cards if c.get("edition") == k and c["status"] in ("open", "escalated")]
        base = launch.get(k, {})
        worst = max((LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] for c in mine), default=0)
        slack = base.get("slack_hours")
        if slack is None:
            slack = clock.slack_hours(cur, k)
        if slack is None:
            vals = [c["slack_hours"] for c in mine if c.get("slack_hours") is not None]
            slack = min(vals) if vals else None
        ed = clock.editions.get(k)
        at_risk = edition_copies_at_risk(
            mine, verifier_at_risk.get(k), ed.remaining if ed else None
        )
        if not mine and k in verifier_at_risk:
            at_risk = verifier_at_risk[k]
        # The line stops when a part runs dry (a card says when), or once it has packed every copy
        # it has parts for (clock), whichever comes first.
        stops_when = [
            t
            for t in (parse_when(c.get("runs_dry")) for c in mine if (c.get("number") or 0) > 0)
            if t
        ]
        by_clock = clock.line_stops(cur, k, at_risk)
        stops = min([*stops_when, *([by_clock] if by_clock else [])], default=None)
        # A stop in the past stays where it was: the line stood still from then on (moving it to
        # 'now' would make it creep on every poll).
        finishes = None if stops else clock.finishes(cur, k)
        # What breaks first is the card whose shortfall sets the line's limit (the largest copies
        # at risk, as edition_copies_at_risk takes the max), not simply the most urgent card;
        # otherwise a stop caused by one part is pinned on another part's decision.
        limiting = [
            c
            for c in mine
            if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk" and (c.get("number") or 0) > 0
        ]
        first = (
            max(limiting, key=lambda c: (c.get("number") or 0, LEVEL_RANK.get(c["level"], 0)))
            if limiting
            else (sorted(mine, key=rank_key)[0] if mine else None)
        )
        breaks = None
        if first:
            breaks = {
                "text": first.get("part") or first.get("headline"),
                "deadline": first.get("deadline"),
                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
                "card": first["id"],
            }
        left = clock.remaining_at(cur, k)
        if stops and stops <= cur and left is not None:  # a stopped line packs nothing more
            left = max(
                left, min(at_risk, ed.remaining if ed and ed.remaining is not None else at_risk)
            )
        rate = ed.rate_per_hour if ed else None
        strip.append(
            {
                "edition": k,
                "label": label_of(k),
                "level": {3: "red", 2: "amber", 1: "grey", 0: "blue"}[worst],
                "status": {3: "Stops the line", 2: "At risk", 1: "Unclear", 0: "On track"}[worst],
                "copies_at_risk": at_risk,
                "slack_hours": slack,
                "breaks_first": breaks,
                "finishes_at": finishes.isoformat() if finishes else None,
                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
                "remaining": round(left) if left is not None else None,
                "rate_per_hour": rate,
                "packed_as_of": ed.packed_as_of.isoformat() if ed and ed.packed_as_of else None,
                # Copies the shifts cannot pack even with every part present (plan rate, hours left).
                "short_of_time": round(max(left - rate * clock.hours_left(cur), 0))
                if left is not None and rate
                else None,
            }
        )
    return strip


def build_clock(strip: list[dict], clock: PackClock, cur: datetime) -> dict:
    """The packing clock for the launch timeline: launch time, the shifts from today's start until
    launch, and per edition when its line finishes or stops."""
    windows = clock.windows
    if not windows:  # no plan and no launch date: the brief's shifts in the coming launch week
        sunday = (cur + timedelta(days=(6 - cur.weekday()) % 7)).date()
        windows = launch_clock.default_windows(sunday, tz())
    launch_at = windows[-1][1]
    day_start = cur.astimezone(tz()).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    keep = [(s, e) for s, e in windows if e > day_start and s < launch_at] or windows[-1:]
    fields = (
        "edition",
        "label",
        "level",
        "finishes_at",
        "stops_at",
        "copies_at_risk",
        "slack_hours",
        "remaining",
        "rate_per_hour",
        "packed_as_of",
        "short_of_time",
    )
    return {
        "launch": launch_at.isoformat(),
        # What leaves at the deadline, per customer (trucks, a ship date, start of production)
        "cutoff": {
            "name": os.environ.get("ASK_CUTOFF_NAME", "the trucks"),
            "short": os.environ.get("ASK_CUTOFF_SHORT", "Trucks"),
        },
        "windows": [[s.isoformat(), e.isoformat()] for s, e in keep],
        "editions": [
            {f: x.get(f) for f in fields}
            | {"breaks_first_card": (x.get("breaks_first") or {}).get("card")}
            for x in strip
        ],
    }


def build_activity(cards: list[dict], events: list[dict], root: Path | None) -> list[dict]:
    items = []
    # Who decided: the card's recorded action (decision_status action_id), else its latest action.
    actions = read_list("actions.json")
    by_id = {a.get("id"): a for a in actions if a.get("id")}
    latest = {str(a.get("decision_id")): a for a in actions}

    def act_of(c: dict) -> dict:
        return by_id.get((c.get("ui") or {}).get("action_id")) or latest.get(c["id"]) or {}

    def via(c: dict) -> str | None:
        return act_of(c).get("via")

    for e in events:
        items.append(
            {"at": e.get("at"), "text": f"Read {e.get('path') or e.get('file')}", "kind": "read"}
        )
    for c in cards:
        if c["status"] in ("dismissed", "logged"):
            items.append(
                {
                    "at": c.get("created_at"),
                    "kind": "dismissed",
                    "card": c["id"],
                    "text": f"{'No launch risk' if c['status'] == 'logged' else 'Dismissed'}: {c['headline']}",
                    "detail": c.get("reason") or c.get("summary"),
                    "via": via(c),
                    "action_id": act_of(c).get("id"),
                }
            )
        elif c["status"] != "open":
            ui = c.get("ui") or {}
            items.append(
                {
                    "at": ui.get("at") or c.get("created_at"),
                    "kind": c["status"],
                    "card": c["id"],
                    "text": f"{c['status'].title()}: {c['headline']}",
                    "detail": ui.get("note"),
                    "via": via(c),
                    "action_id": act_of(c).get("id"),
                }
            )
    items.sort(
        key=lambda x: parse_ts(x.get("at")) or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=tz()), reverse=True
    )
    return items[:40]


def event_node(path: str, net: dict) -> str | None:
    nodes = net.get("nodes") or {}
    for seg in str(path).split("/"):
        sid = seg.split("_")[0]
        if sid in nodes:
            return sid
    return next((n["id"] for n in nodes.values() if n["kind"] == "dc"), None)


def newest_mtime(root: Path | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not root:
        return None
    best = 0.0
    for p in root.rglob("*"):
        if p.is_file():
            best = max(best, p.stat().st_mtime)
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(best, tz()) if best else None


def build_state() -> dict:
    cur = now()
    net = load_network()
    root = net["root"]
    silent_h = float(os.environ.get("ASK_SILENT_HOURS", "18"))
    upds = [u for u in (parse_ts(r.get("updated_at")) for r in net["shipments_raw"]) if u]
    ref = max(upds) if upds else None
    ships = {}
    for r in net["shipments_raw"]:
        v = shipment_view(r, cur, ref, silent_h)
        if v and v["id"] and v["status"] not in ("delivered", "received", "cancelled"):
            ships[v["id"]] = v
    cards = build_cards(net, ships)
    open_cards = [c for c in cards if c["status"] == "open"]

    route_level: dict[str, str] = {}
    badges: Counter = Counter()
    ship_level: dict[str, str] = {}
    for c in cards:
        if c["status"] not in ("open", "escalated"):
            continue
        for r in c["routes"]:
            if LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] >= LEVEL_RANK[route_level.get(r, "blue")]:
                route_level[r] = c["level"]
        if c["shipment"] in ships:
            ship_level[c["shipment"]] = c["level"]
        badges[
            c["supplier_id"]
            or next((n["id"] for n in net["nodes"].values() if n["kind"] == "dc"), "")
        ] += 1
    for s in ships.values():
        s["level"] = ship_level.get(s["id"]) or ("grey" if s["silent"] else "blue")

    events = sorted(read_list("events.json"), key=lambda e: str(e.get("at")), reverse=True)
    for e in events:
        e["node"] = event_node(e.get("path") or e.get("file") or "", net)
        e["id"] = (
            e.get("id")
            or hashlib.sha1(f"{e.get('at')}{e.get('path') or e.get('file')}".encode()).hexdigest()[
                :10
            ]
        )
    status = read_json("status.json", {})
    last_drop = parse_ts((events[0].get("at") if events else None)) or newest_mtime(root)
    last_check = parse_ts(status.get("last_check_at")) or last_drop
    since = cur.replace(hour=6, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    if cur < since:
        since -= timedelta(days=1)
    read_n = (
        status.get("files_read_since_06")
        if isinstance(status.get("files_read_since_06"), int)
        else sum(1 for e in events if (parse_ts(e.get("at")) or since) >= since)
    )

    inbox = [c for c in open_cards if not c["routed_to_other"]]
    clock = launch_clock.load(root, tz())
    strip = build_strip(cards, root, clock, cur)
    return {
        "now": cur.isoformat(),
        "viewer": viewer_name(root),
        "portal_found": root is not None,
        "map": {
            "nodes": list((net["nodes"] or {}).values()),
            "legs": net["legs"],
            "version": hashlib.sha1(
                json.dumps([net["nodes"], net["legs"]], sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()
            ).hexdigest()[:8],
        },
        "route_level": route_level,
        "badges": dict(badges),
        "shipments": list(ships.values()),
        "strip": strip,
        "clock": build_clock(strip, clock, cur),
        "launch": launch_view.build(cards, net["shipments_raw"], clock, cur, strip),
        "cards": cards,
        "inbox_ids": [c["id"] for c in inbox],
        "calm": not inbox,
        "events": events[:20],
        "activity": build_activity(cards, events, root),
        "last_drop_at": last_drop.isoformat() if last_drop else None,
        "last_check_at": last_check.isoformat() if last_check else None,
        "read_since_6": read_n,
        "trust": read_json("trust.json", {}),
    }

def _card(card_id: str) -> dict:
    for c in build_state()["cards"]:
        if c["id"] == card_id:
            return c
    raise HTTPException(404, "unknown card")


def _record(card_id: str, status: str, action: dict) -> dict:
    stamp = now().isoformat()
    with _lock:
        actions = read_list("actions.json")
        action = {"id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:10], "decision_id": card_id, "at": stamp, **action}
        actions.append(action)
        write_json("actions.json", actions)
        sts = read_json("decision_status.json", {})
        sts[card_id] = {
            "status": status,
            "at": stamp,
            "note": action.get("note"),
            "action_id": action["id"],
        }
        write_json("decision_status.json", sts)
    return action


@app.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/approve")
def approve(card_id: str, body: dict = Body(default_factory=dict)) -> dict:
    card = _card(card_id)
    idx = int(body.get("option", 0))
    if idx >= len(card["options"]):
        raise HTTPException(400, "unknown option")
    opt = card["options"][idx]
    trust = read_json("trust.json", {})
    # Same send path for the Approve button and a spoken yes (alert agent, cardtools.deliver):
    # an email option to a known supplier address goes out now; anything else is only recorded.
    from ask_soony.cardtools import deliver

    sent = deliver(card, opt, body.get("text"))
    status = "sent" if sent else "approved"
    action = _record(
        card_id,
        status,
        {
            "kind": "approve",
            "option": idx,
            "action": opt["action"],
            "channel": opt.get("channel"),
            "to": opt.get("to"),
            "draft": body.get("text") or opt.get("draft"),
            "edited": bool(body.get("text") and body.get("text") != opt.get("draft")),
            "trust": "allow_always"
            if trust.get(opt.get("routine_type") or "") == "allow_always"
            else "allow_once",
            "status": status,
            "action_type": opt.get("routine_type"),
            "via": body.get("via") or "inbox",
            **({"message_id": sent["message_id"], "subject": sent["subject"]} if sent else {}),
        },
    )
    offer = (
        opt.get("routine_type")
        if opt.get("routine_type") and opt["routine_type"] not in trust
        else None
    )
    return {"action": action, "offer_trust": offer}

347	def edition_copies_at_risk(
348	    mine: list[dict], verifier_figure: float | None, remaining: float | None
349	) -> float:
350	    """Copies at risk for one edition, always a number the user can find on screen.
351	
352	    Rule: the largest 'copies at risk' figure among the edition's open cards, or the verifier's
353	    edition total when that is higher (it covers its own cards without double counting). Max, not
354	    sum: every box needs all its parts, so shortfalls of different parts hit the same unpacked
355	    copies and the scarcest part bounds the loss. Cards counted in parts ('units short') are left
356	    out. Never more than the copies still to pack.
357	    """
358	    figures = [c.get("number") or 0 for c in mine if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk"]
359	    best = max([*figures, verifier_figure or 0])
360	    return min(best, remaining) if remaining is not None else best

363	def build_strip(
364	    cards: list[dict], root: Path | None, clock: PackClock, cur: datetime
365	) -> list[dict]:
366	    """One cell per launch edition. Slack and the time a line stops come from the packing clock
367	    (shift windows, rate, copies left), so a line never 'stops' at night. Each cell also carries
368	    when the line finishes or stops, for the launch timeline (build_clock)."""
369	    launch = {
370	        str(e.get("edition")): e for e in (read_json("launch.json", {}).get("editions") or [])
371	    }
372	    labels = edition_labels(root)
373	    try:  # the verifier prices copies at risk per edition without double counting shared parts
374	        vdata = json.loads(cards_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
375	        verifier_at_risk = {
376	            str(e["product"]): num(e.get("at_risk")) or 0 for e in vdata.get("editions") or []
377	        }
378	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
379	        verifier_at_risk = {}
380	    keys: list[str] = list(launch)
381	    for k in [*labels, *(c["edition"] for c in cards if c.get("edition"))]:
382	        if k not in keys:
383	            keys.append(k)
384	
385	    def label_of(k: str) -> str:
386	        if k in launch and launch[k].get("label"):
387	            return launch[k]["label"]
388	        for pid, lab in labels.items():
389	            if k == pid or k.lower() in lab.lower() or lab.lower().startswith(k.lower()):
390	                return lab
391	        return k.replace("_", " ").title()
392	
393	    strip = []
394	    for k in keys:
395	        mine = [c for c in cards if c.get("edition") == k and c["status"] in ("open", "escalated")]
396	        base = launch.get(k, {})
397	        worst = max((LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] for c in mine), default=0)
398	        slack = base.get("slack_hours")
399	        if slack is None:
400	            slack = clock.slack_hours(cur, k)
401	        if slack is None:
402	            vals = [c["slack_hours"] for c in mine if c.get("slack_hours") is not None]
403	            slack = min(vals) if vals else None
404	        ed = clock.editions.get(k)
405	        at_risk = edition_copies_at_risk(
406	            mine, verifier_at_risk.get(k), ed.remaining if ed else None
407	        )
408	        if not mine and k in verifier_at_risk:
409	            at_risk = verifier_at_risk[k]
410	        # The line stops when a part runs dry (a card says when), or once it has packed every copy
411	        # it has parts for (clock), whichever comes first.
412	        stops_when = [
413	            t
414	            for t in (parse_when(c.get("runs_dry")) for c in mine if (c.get("number") or 0) > 0)
415	            if t
416	        ]
417	        by_clock = clock.line_stops(cur, k, at_risk)
418	        stops = min([*stops_when, *([by_clock] if by_clock else [])], default=None)
419	        # A stop in the past stays where it was: the line stood still from then on (moving it to
420	        # 'now' would make it creep on every poll).
421	        finishes = None if stops else clock.finishes(cur, k)
422	        # What breaks first is the card whose shortfall sets the line's limit (the largest copies
423	        # at risk, as edition_copies_at_risk takes the max), not simply the most urgent card;
424	        # otherwise a stop caused by one part is pinned on another part's decision.
425	        limiting = [
426	            c
427	            for c in mine
428	            if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk" and (c.get("number") or 0) > 0
429	        ]
430	        first = (
431	            max(limiting, key=lambda c: (c.get("number") or 0, LEVEL_RANK.get(c["level"], 0)))
432	            if limiting
433	            else (sorted(mine, key=rank_key)[0] if mine else None)
434	        )
435	        breaks = None
436	        if first:
437	            breaks = {
438	                "text": first.get("part") or first.get("headline"),
439	                "deadline": first.get("deadline"),
440	                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
441	                "card": first["id"],
442	            }
443	        left = clock.remaining_at(cur, k)
444	        if stops and stops <= cur and left is not None:  # a stopped line packs nothing more
445	            left = max(
446	                left, min(at_risk, ed.remaining if ed and ed.remaining is not None else at_risk)
447	            )
448	        rate = ed.rate_per_hour if ed else None
449	        strip.append(
450	            {
451	                "edition": k,
452	                "label": label_of(k),
453	                "level": {3: "red", 2: "amber", 1: "grey", 0: "blue"}[worst],
454	                "status": {3: "Stops the line", 2: "At risk", 1: "Unclear", 0: "On track"}[worst],
455	                "copies_at_risk": at_risk,
456	                "slack_hours": slack,
457	                "breaks_first": breaks,
458	                "finishes_at": finishes.isoformat() if finishes else None,
459	                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
460	                "remaining": round(left) if left is not None else None,
461	                "rate_per_hour": rate,
462	                "packed_as_of": ed.packed_as_of.isoformat() if ed and ed.packed_as_of else None,
463	                # Copies the shifts cannot pack even with every part present (plan rate, hours left).
464	                "short_of_time": round(max(left - rate * clock.hours_left(cur), 0))
465	                if left is not None and rate
466	                else None,
467	            }
468	        )
469	    return strip

472	def build_clock(strip: list[dict], clock: PackClock, cur: datetime) -> dict:
473	    """The packing clock for the launch timeline: launch time, the shifts from today's start until
474	    launch, and per edition when its line finishes or stops."""
475	    windows = clock.windows
476	    if not windows:  # no plan and no launch date: the brief's shifts in the coming launch week
477	        sunday = (cur + timedelta(days=(6 - cur.weekday()) % 7)).date()
478	        windows = launch_clock.default_windows(sunday, tz())
479	    launch_at = windows[-1][1]
480	    day_start = cur.astimezone(tz()).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
481	    keep = [(s, e) for s, e in windows if e > day_start and s < launch_at] or windows[-1:]
482	    fields = (
483	        "edition",
484	        "label",
485	        "level",
486	        "finishes_at",
487	        "stops_at",
488	        "copies_at_risk",
489	        "slack_hours",
490	        "remaining",
491	        "rate_per_hour",
492	        "packed_as_of",
493	        "short_of_time",
494	    )
495	    return {
496	        "launch": launch_at.isoformat(),
497	        # What leaves at the deadline, per customer (trucks, a ship date, start of production)
498	        "cutoff": {
499	            "name": os.environ.get("ASK_CUTOFF_NAME", "the trucks"),
500	            "short": os.environ.get("ASK_CUTOFF_SHORT", "Trucks"),
501	        },
502	        "windows": [[s.isoformat(), e.isoformat()] for s, e in keep],
503	        "editions": [
504	            {f: x.get(f) for f in fields}
505	            | {"breaks_first_card": (x.get("breaks_first") or {}).get("card")}
506	            for x in strip
507	        ],
508	    }

579	def build_state() -> dict:
580	    cur = now()
581	    net = load_network()
582	    root = net["root"]
583	    silent_h = float(os.environ.get("ASK_SILENT_HOURS", "18"))
584	    upds = [u for u in (parse_ts(r.get("updated_at")) for r in net["shipments_raw"]) if u]
585	    ref = max(upds) if upds else None
586	    ships = {}
587	    for r in net["shipments_raw"]:
588	        v = shipment_view(r, cur, ref, silent_h)
589	        if v and v["id"] and v["status"] not in ("delivered", "received", "cancelled"):
590	            ships[v["id"]] = v
591	    cards = build_cards(net, ships)
592	    open_cards = [c for c in cards if c["status"] == "open"]
593	
594	    route_level: dict[str, str] = {}
595	    badges: Counter = Counter()
596	    ship_level: dict[str, str] = {}
597	    for c in cards:
598	        if c["status"] not in ("open", "escalated"):
599	            continue
600	        for r in c["routes"]:
601	            if LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] >= LEVEL_RANK[route_level.get(r, "blue")]:
602	                route_level[r] = c["level"]
603	        if c["shipment"] in ships:
604	            ship_level[c["shipment"]] = c["level"]
605	        badges[
606	            c["supplier_id"]
607	            or next((n["id"] for n in net["nodes"].values() if n["kind"] == "dc"), "")
608	        ] += 1
609	    for s in ships.values():
610	        s["level"] = ship_level.get(s["id"]) or ("grey" if s["silent"] else "blue")
611	
612	    events = sorted(read_list("events.json"), key=lambda e: str(e.get("at")), reverse=True)
613	    for e in events:
614	        e["node"] = event_node(e.get("path") or e.get("file") or "", net)
615	        e["id"] = (
616	            e.get("id")
617	            or hashlib.sha1(f"{e.get('at')}{e.get('path') or e.get('file')}".encode()).hexdigest()[
618	                :10
619	            ]
620	        )
621	    status = read_json("status.json", {})
622	    last_drop = parse_ts((events[0].get("at") if events else None)) or newest_mtime(root)
623	    last_check = parse_ts(status.get("last_check_at")) or last_drop
624	    since = cur.replace(hour=6, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
625	    if cur < since:
626	        since -= timedelta(days=1)
627	    read_n = (
628	        status.get("files_read_since_06")
629	        if isinstance(status.get("files_read_since_06"), int)
630	        else sum(1 for e in events if (parse_ts(e.get("at")) or since) >= since)
631	    )
632	
633	    inbox = [c for c in open_cards if not c["routed_to_other"]]
634	    clock = launch_clock.load(root, tz())
635	    strip = build_strip(cards, root, clock, cur)
636	    return {
637	        "now": cur.isoformat(),
638	        "viewer": viewer_name(root),
639	        "portal_found": root is not None,
640	        "map": {
641	            "nodes": list((net["nodes"] or {}).values()),
642	            "legs": net["legs"],
643	            "version": hashlib.sha1(
644	                json.dumps([net["nodes"], net["legs"]], sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()
645	            ).hexdigest()[:8],
646	        },
647	        "route_level": route_level,
648	        "badges": dict(badges),
649	        "shipments": list(ships.values()),
650	        "strip": strip,
651	        "clock": build_clock(strip, clock, cur),
652	        "launch": launch_view.build(cards, net["shipments_raw"], clock, cur, strip),
653	        "cards": cards,
654	        "inbox_ids": [c["id"] for c in inbox],
655	        "calm": not inbox,
656	        "events": events[:20],
657	        "activity": build_activity(cards, events, root),
658	        "last_drop_at": last_drop.isoformat() if last_drop else None,
659	        "last_check_at": last_check.isoformat() if last_check else None,
660	        "read_since_6": read_n,

702	def approve(card_id: str, body: dict = Body(default_factory=dict)) -> dict:
703	    card = _card(card_id)
704	    idx = int(body.get("option", 0))
705	    if idx >= len(card["options"]):
706	        raise HTTPException(400, "unknown option")
707	    opt = card["options"][idx]
708	    trust = read_json("trust.json", {})
709	    # Same send path for the Approve button and a spoken yes (alert agent, cardtools.deliver):
710	    # an email option to a known supplier address goes out now; anything else is only recorded.
711	    from ask_soony.cardtools import deliver
712	
713	    sent = deliver(card, opt, body.get("text"))
714	    status = "sent" if sent else "approved"
715	    action = _record(
716	        card_id,
717	        status,
718	        {
719	            "kind": "approve",
720	            "option": idx,
721	            "action": opt["action"],
722	            "channel": opt.get("channel"),
723	            "to": opt.get("to"),
724	            "draft": body.get("text") or opt.get("draft"),
725	            "edited": bool(body.get("text") and body.get("text") != opt.get("draft")),
726	            "trust": "allow_always"
727	            if trust.get(opt.get("routine_type") or "") == "allow_always"
728	            else "allow_once",
729	            "status": status,
730	            "action_type": opt.get("routine_type"),
731	            "via": body.get("via") or "inbox",
732	            **({"message_id": sent["message_id"], "subject": sent["subject"]} if sent else {}),
733	        },
734	    )

def _iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    dt = parse_when(value)
    return dt.isoformat() if dt else None


def _ui_status(cid: str, statuses: dict, default: str = "open") -> tuple[str, dict]:
    ui = statuses.get(cid, {})
    return ui.get("status", default), ui


def _base_card(cid: str, **kw) -> dict:
    card = {
        "id": cid,
        "kind": None,
        "part": None,
        "headline": cid,
        "summary": None,
        "number": None,
        "number_label": "copies at risk",
        "edition": None,
        "cell_hours_lost": None,
        "slack_hours": None,
        "deadline": None,
        "runs_dry": None,
        "arrives_at": None,
        "severity": None,
        "level": "blue",
        "status": "open",
        "approver": None,
        "routed_to_other": False,
        "reason": None,
        "called_at": None,
        "options": [],
        "evidence": [],
        "trail": [],
        "supplier_id": None,
        "supplier_name": None,
        "shipment": None,
        "routes": [],
        "ui": {},
        "created_at": None,
        "escalation_brief": "",
        "trusted_types": [],
    }
    card.update(kw)
    return card


_MONEY = re.compile(r"(\d[\d,.]*)\s*(EUR|USD|PLN|€|\$)")


def verifier_cards(
    net: dict, statuses: dict, actions: list[dict], trust: dict, viewer: str
) -> list[dict]:
    """The verifier's decisions (dispatch.json `decisions`, or decision_cards.json `cards`) as UI cards.

    Each ready message becomes an option (send it); the verifier's own option lines are facts about
    supply and timing and go into the recommended option's effect. Routing (plan.md §5): a card
    whose recommended action costs money, or whose recommendation is a decision message, goes to
    the person who must decide; routine supplier questions and internal notes stay with the buyer.
    """
    f = cards_file()
    try:
        data = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return []
    items = data.get("decisions") or data.get("cards") or []
    nodes = net.get("nodes") or {}
    made = datetime.fromtimestamp(f.stat().st_mtime, tz()).isoformat()
    approver_of_exceptions = exception_approver() if items else None
    descriptions = {
        str(p.get("part")): p.get("description")
        for p in data.get("parts") or []
        if p.get("description")
    }
    out = []
    for vc in items:
        cid = str(vc.get("id") or "")
        if not cid:
            continue
        msgs = vc.get("messages") or []
        facts = [str(x) for x in vc.get("options") or []]
        at_risk = num(vc.get("at_risk")) or 0
        if_acted = num(vc.get("at_risk_if_acted"))
        runs_dry = _iso(vc.get("runs_dry"))
        level = (
            "red"
            if at_risk and runs_dry
            else "amber"
            if at_risk or vc.get("blocked_only")
            else "blue"
        )
        supplier = next(
            (
                sid
                for sid, n in nodes.items()
                if n.get("kind") == "supplier"
                and (
                    any(n.get("name") and n["name"] in str(m.get("to_role")) for m in msgs)
                    or any(sid in str(e) for e in vc.get("evidence") or [])
                )
            ),
            None,
        )

        options = []
        for i, m in enumerate(msgs):
            who = person_of(m.get("to_role")) or "recipient"
            external = bool(m.get("to_email"))
            subject = str(m.get("subject") or "")
            names = [
                str(n.get("name"))
                for n in nodes.values()
                if n.get("name") and n["name"] in str(m.get("to_role"))
            ]
            cost_line = next(
                (
                    x
                    for x in facts
                    if _MONEY.search(x) and (not names or any(nm in x for nm in names))
                ),
                None,
            )
            cost_m = _MONEY.search(cost_line) if cost_line and external else None
            cost_value = num(cost_m.group(1)) if cost_m else None
            commits = external and (cost_value or subject.lower().startswith("order"))
            options.append(
                {
                    "index": i,
                    "action": f"{'Email' if external else 'Message'} {who}: {subject}",
                    "cost": (f"about {cost_m.group(1)} {cost_m.group(2)}" if cost_m else "No cost"),
                    "cost_value": cost_value,
                    "effect": None,
                    "recommended": False,
                    "draft": m.get("body"),
                    "to": m.get("to_email") or m.get("to_role"),
                    "to_role": m.get("to_role"),
                    "channel": "email" if external else "notify",
                    "routine_type": None
                    if commits
                    else ("supplier_question" if external else "internal_note"),
                }
            )
        rec = next((o for o in options if o["channel"] == "email"), options[0] if options else None)
        if rec:
            rec["recommended"] = True
            saved = at_risk - if_acted if if_acted is not None else None
            rec["effect"] = (
                "; ".join(
                    [*([f"saves {saved:,.0f} copies if it lands in time"] if saved else []), *facts]
                )
                or None
            )
            options.remove(rec)
            options.insert(0, rec)
            for i, o in enumerate(options):
                o["index"] = i
        decision_msg = next(
            (o for o in options if o["channel"] == "notify" and vc.get("decision")), None
        )
        if rec and (
            rec.get("cost_value") or rec["routine_type"] is None and rec["channel"] == "email"
        ):
            approver = approver_of_exceptions or person_of((decision_msg or {}).get("to_role"))
            reason = f"Commits money ({rec['cost']}): above the buyer's routine"
        elif rec and rec is decision_msg:
            approver = person_of(rec.get("to_role"))
            reason = vc.get("decision")
        else:
            approver = viewer or None
            reason = (
                f"Decision for {person_of(decision_msg['to_role'])}: {vc.get('decision')}"
                if decision_msg
                else "Routine, no cost"
            )
        if (
            level == "red"
            and approver == viewer
            and approver_of_exceptions
            and rec
            and rec.get("cost_value")
        ):
            approver = approver_of_exceptions
        edition = str(vc.get("edition") or "").split(" + ")[0] or None
        status, ui = _ui_status(cid, statuses)
        called = next(
            (
                a
                for a in reversed(actions)
                if str(a.get("decision_id")) == cid and a.get("channel") == "call" and a.get("at")
            ),
            None,
        )
        approver = person_of(approver)
        deadline = parse_when(vc.get("act_by"))
        if deadline and deadline < now():
            reason = f"{reason} · The verifier's decide-by ({fmt_dt(deadline)}, as of the stock data) has passed"
        card = _base_card(
            cid,
            kind="mismatch",
            part=descriptions.get(str(vc.get("part"))) or vc.get("part"),
            headline=vc.get("title") or cid,
            summary=vc.get("decision"),
            number=at_risk,
            edition=edition,
            deadline=_iso(vc.get("act_by")),
            runs_dry=runs_dry,
            level=level,
            status=status,
            ui=ui,
            approver=approver,
            routed_to_other=bool(
                approver and viewer and first_name(person_of(approver)) != first_name(viewer)
            ),
            reason=reason,
            called_at=called.get("at") if called else None,
            options=options,
            created_at=made,
            evidence=[
                {"source": "System says", "value": vc.get("system_says")},
                {"source": "Paper says", "value": vc.get("paper_says")},
                *({"source": "Evidence", "quote": e} for e in vc.get("evidence") or []),
                *documents_by_part().get(str(vc.get("part")), []),
            ],
            trail=[
                {
                    "agent": "Verification",
                    "at": made,
                    "text": "Linked orders, receipts, scans and stock; priced the gap.",
                },
                {"agent": "Routing", "at": made, "text": f"{reason} → {approver or 'buyer'}."},
            ],
            supplier_id=supplier,
            supplier_name=(nodes.get(supplier) or {}).get("name"),
            trusted_types=[k for k, v in trust.items() if v == "allow_always"],
        )
        card["escalation_brief"] = escalation_brief(
            {"summary": card["headline"]}, {"deadline": card["deadline"]}, {}, options, viewer
        )
        out.append(card)
    return out


def event_cards(net: dict, statuses: dict, trust: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """News and notice impacts from the event impact agent (state/impacts.json keyed by event)."""
    data = read_json("impacts.json", [])
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return []
    nodes = net.get("nodes") or {}
    out = []
    for eid, r in data.items():
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or "overall_launch_risk" not in r:
            continue
        cid = "EV-" + hashlib.sha1(str(eid).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        risk = r.get("overall_launch_risk")
        affected = r.get("affected") or []
        hit = next(
            (a for a in affected if a.get("launch_risk") == "yes"), affected[0] if affected else {}
        )
        status, ui = _ui_status(cid, statuses, "open" if risk == "yes" else "logged")
        supplier = hit.get("supplier_id") if hit.get("supplier_id") in nodes else None
        out.append(
            _base_card(
                cid,
                kind="risk_news",
                part=hit.get("component_id"),
                headline=r.get("event_summary") or str(eid),
                summary=r.get("recommendation"),
                level="amber" if risk == "yes" else "grey",
                status=status,
                ui=ui,
                reason=(
                    r.get("recommendation")
                    if risk == "yes"
                    else "; ".join(a.get("mechanism", "") for a in affected[:2])
                    or "No part of the launch is touched."
                ),
                created_at=r.get("analysed_at"),
                supplier_id=supplier,
                supplier_name=(nodes.get(supplier) or {}).get("name"),
                evidence=[
                    {
                        "source": a.get("supplier_id"),
                        "value": f"{a.get('effect')}, launch risk {a.get('launch_risk')}",
                        "quote": a.get("evidence"),
                    }
                    for a in affected
                ],
                trail=[
                    {
                        "agent": "Event impact",
                        "at": r.get("analysed_at"),
                        "text": f"Read {r.get('source')}.",
                    }
                ],
                trusted_types=[k for k, v in trust.items() if v == "allow_always"],
            )
        )
    return out


def escalation_brief(f: dict, d: dict, imp: dict, options: list[dict], viewer: str) -> str:
    lead = options[0] if options else {}
    parts = [
        f"{first_name(viewer) or 'The buyer'} needs your decision: {d.get('headline') or f.get('summary') or ''}."
    ]
    if d.get("deadline") or imp.get("deadline"):
        parts.append(f"Decide by {d.get('deadline') or imp.get('deadline')}.")
    if lead:
        parts.append(
            f"Recommended: {lead.get('action')} ({lead.get('cost') or 'no cost stated'}). {lead.get('effect') or ''}"
        )
    return " ".join(p.strip() for p in parts if p)


def rank_key(c: dict):
    dl = parse_ts(c.get("deadline"))
    return (
        -LEVEL_RANK.get(c["level"], 0),
        dl.timestamp() if dl else math.inf,
        -(c.get("number") or 0),
    )

def edition_labels(root: Path | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Launch editions named in products.csv, keyed by product id."""
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    if root:
        for r in read_csv(root / "soony" / "master" / "products.csv"):
            if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch":
                name = r.get("name", "")
                label = name.split("–")[-1].split("(")[0].strip() if "–" in name else name
                out[r["product_id"]] = label.replace(" Edition", "")
    return out


def edition_copies_at_risk(
    mine: list[dict], verifier_figure: float | None, remaining: float | None
) -> float:
    """Copies at risk for one edition, always a number the user can find on screen.

    Rule: the largest 'copies at risk' figure among the edition's open cards, or the verifier's
    edition total when that is higher (it covers its own cards without double counting). Max, not
    sum: every box needs all its parts, so shortfalls of different parts hit the same unpacked
    copies and the scarcest part bounds the loss. Cards counted in parts ('units short') are left
    out. Never more than the copies still to pack.
    """
    figures = [c.get("number") or 0 for c in mine if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk"]
    best = max([*figures, verifier_figure or 0])
    return min(best, remaining) if remaining is not None else best


def build_strip(
    cards: list[dict], root: Path | None, clock: PackClock, cur: datetime
) -> list[dict]:
    """One cell per launch edition. Slack and the time a line stops come from the packing clock
    (shift windows, rate, copies left), so a line never 'stops' at night. Each cell also carries
    when the line finishes or stops, for the launch timeline (build_clock)."""
    launch = {
        str(e.get("edition")): e for e in (read_json("launch.json", {}).get("editions") or [])
    }
    labels = edition_labels(root)
    try:  # the verifier prices copies at risk per edition without double counting shared parts
        vdata = json.loads(cards_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        verifier_at_risk = {
            str(e["product"]): num(e.get("at_risk")) or 0 for e in vdata.get("editions") or []
        }
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        verifier_at_risk = {}
    keys: list[str] = list(launch)
    for k in [*labels, *(c["edition"] for c in cards if c.get("edition"))]:
        if k not in keys:
            keys.append(k)

    def label_of(k: str) -> str:
        if k in launch and launch[k].get("label"):
            return launch[k]["label"]
        for pid, lab in labels.items():
            if k == pid or k.lower() in lab.lower() or lab.lower().startswith(k.lower()):
                return lab
        return k.replace("_", " ").title()

    strip = []
    for k in keys:
        mine = [c for c in cards if c.get("edition") == k and c["status"] in ("open", "escalated")]
        base = launch.get(k, {})
        worst = max((LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] for c in mine), default=0)
        slack = base.get("slack_hours")
        if slack is None:
            slack = clock.slack_hours(cur, k)
        if slack is None:
            vals = [c["slack_hours"] for c in mine if c.get("slack_hours") is not None]
            slack = min(vals) if vals else None
        ed = clock.editions.get(k)
        at_risk = edition_copies_at_risk(
            mine, verifier_at_risk.get(k), ed.remaining if ed else None
        )
        if not mine and k in verifier_at_risk:
            at_risk = verifier_at_risk[k]
        # The line stops when a part runs dry (a card says when), or once it has packed every copy
        # it has parts for (clock), whichever comes first.
        stops_when = [
            t
            for t in (parse_when(c.get("runs_dry")) for c in mine if (c.get("number") or 0) > 0)
            if t
        ]
        by_clock = clock.line_stops(cur, k, at_risk)
        stops = min([*stops_when, *([by_clock] if by_clock else [])], default=None)
        # A stop in the past stays where it was: the line stood still from then on (moving it to
        # 'now' would make it creep on every poll).
        finishes = None if stops else clock.finishes(cur, k)
        # What breaks first is the card whose shortfall sets the line's limit (the largest copies
        # at risk, as edition_copies_at_risk takes the max), not simply the most urgent card;
        # otherwise a stop caused by one part is pinned on another part's decision.
        limiting = [
            c
            for c in mine
            if c.get("number_label") == "copies at risk" and (c.get("number") or 0) > 0
        ]
        first = (
            max(limiting, key=lambda c: (c.get("number") or 0, LEVEL_RANK.get(c["level"], 0)))
            if limiting
            else (sorted(mine, key=rank_key)[0] if mine else None)
        )
        breaks = None
        if first:
            breaks = {
                "text": first.get("part") or first.get("headline"),
                "deadline": first.get("deadline"),
                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
                "card": first["id"],
            }
        left = clock.remaining_at(cur, k)
        if stops and stops <= cur and left is not None:  # a stopped line packs nothing more
            left = max(
                left, min(at_risk, ed.remaining if ed and ed.remaining is not None else at_risk)
            )
        rate = ed.rate_per_hour if ed else None
        strip.append(
            {
                "edition": k,
                "label": label_of(k),
                "level": {3: "red", 2: "amber", 1: "grey", 0: "blue"}[worst],
                "status": {3: "Stops the line", 2: "At risk", 1: "Unclear", 0: "On track"}[worst],
                "copies_at_risk": at_risk,
                "slack_hours": slack,
                "breaks_first": breaks,
                "finishes_at": finishes.isoformat() if finishes else None,
                "stops_at": stops.isoformat() if stops else None,
                "remaining": round(left) if left is not None else None,
                "rate_per_hour": rate,
                "packed_as_of": ed.packed_as_of.isoformat() if ed and ed.packed_as_of else None,
                # Copies the shifts cannot pack even with every part present (plan rate, hours left).
                "short_of_time": round(max(left - rate * clock.hours_left(cur), 0))
                if left is not None and rate
                else None,
            }
        )
    return strip


def build_clock(strip: list[dict], clock: PackClock, cur: datetime) -> dict:
    """The packing clock for the launch timeline: launch time, the shifts from today's start until
    launch, and per edition when its line finishes or stops."""
    windows = clock.windows
    if not windows:  # no plan and no launch date: the brief's shifts in the coming launch week
        sunday = (cur + timedelta(days=(6 - cur.weekday()) % 7)).date()
        windows = launch_clock.default_windows(sunday, tz())
    launch_at = windows[-1][1]
    day_start = cur.astimezone(tz()).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    keep = [(s, e) for s, e in windows if e > day_start and s < launch_at] or windows[-1:]
    fields = (
        "edition",
        "label",
        "level",
        "finishes_at",
        "stops_at",
        "copies_at_risk",
        "slack_hours",
        "remaining",
        "rate_per_hour",
        "packed_as_of",
        "short_of_time",
    )
    return {
        "launch": launch_at.isoformat(),
        # What leaves at the deadline, per customer (trucks, a ship date, start of production)
        "cutoff": {
            "name": os.environ.get("ASK_CUTOFF_NAME", "the trucks"),
            "short": os.environ.get("ASK_CUTOFF_SHORT", "Trucks"),
        },
        "windows": [[s.isoformat(), e.isoformat()] for s, e in keep],
        "editions": [
            {f: x.get(f) for f in fields}
            | {"breaks_first_card": (x.get("breaks_first") or {}).get("card")}
            for x in strip
        ],
    }


def build_activity(cards: list[dict], events: list[dict], root: Path | None) -> list[dict]:
    items = []
    # Who decided: the card's recorded action (decision_status action_id), else its latest action.
    actions = read_list("actions.json")
    by_id = {a.get("id"): a for a in actions if a.get("id")}
    latest = {str(a.get("decision_id")): a for a in actions}

    def act_of(c: dict) -> dict:
        return by_id.get((c.get("ui") or {}).get("action_id")) or latest.get(c["id"]) or {}

    def via(c: dict) -> str | None:
        return act_of(c).get("via")

    for e in events:
        items.append(
            {"at": e.get("at"), "text": f"Read {e.get('path') or e.get('file')}", "kind": "read"}
        )
    for c in cards:
        if c["status"] in ("dismissed", "logged"):
            items.append(
                {
                    "at": c.get("created_at"),
                    "kind": "dismissed",
                    "card": c["id"],
                    "text": f"{'No launch risk' if c['status'] == 'logged' else 'Dismissed'}: {c['headline']}",
                    "detail": c.get("reason") or c.get("summary"),
                    "via": via(c),
                    "action_id": act_of(c).get("id"),
                }
            )
        elif c["status"] != "open":
            ui = c.get("ui") or {}
            items.append(
                {
                    "at": ui.get("at") or c.get("created_at"),
                    "kind": c["status"],
                    "card": c["id"],
                    "text": f"{c['status'].title()}: {c['headline']}",
                    "detail": ui.get("note"),
                    "via": via(c),
                    "action_id": act_of(c).get("id"),
                }
            )
    items.sort(
        key=lambda x: parse_ts(x.get("at")) or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=tz()), reverse=True
    )
    return items[:40]


def event_node(path: str, net: dict) -> str | None:
    nodes = net.get("nodes") or {}
    for seg in str(path).split("/"):
        sid = seg.split("_")[0]
        if sid in nodes:
            return sid
    return next((n["id"] for n in nodes.values() if n["kind"] == "dc"), None)


def newest_mtime(root: Path | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not root:
        return None
    best = 0.0
    for p in root.rglob("*"):
        if p.is_file():
            best = max(best, p.stat().st_mtime)
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(best, tz()) if best else None


def build_state() -> dict:
    cur = now()
    net = load_network()
    root = net["root"]
    silent_h = float(os.environ.get("ASK_SILENT_HOURS", "18"))
    upds = [u for u in (parse_ts(r.get("updated_at")) for r in net["shipments_raw"]) if u]
    ref = max(upds) if upds else None
    ships = {}
    for r in net["shipments_raw"]:
        v = shipment_view(r, cur, ref, silent_h)
        if v and v["id"] and v["status"] not in ("delivered", "received", "cancelled"):
            ships[v["id"]] = v
    cards = build_cards(net, ships)
    open_cards = [c for c in cards if c["status"] == "open"]

    route_level: dict[str, str] = {}
    badges: Counter = Counter()
    ship_level: dict[str, str] = {}
    for c in cards:
        if c["status"] not in ("open", "escalated"):
            continue
        for r in c["routes"]:
            if LEVEL_RANK[c["level"]] >= LEVEL_RANK[route_level.get(r, "blue")]:
                route_level[r] = c["level"]
        if c["shipment"] in ships:
            ship_level[c["shipment"]] = c["level"]
        badges[
            c["supplier_id"]
            or next((n["id"] for n in net["nodes"].values() if n["kind"] == "dc"), "")
        ] += 1
    for s in ships.values():
        s["level"] = ship_level.get(s["id"]) or ("grey" if s["silent"] else "blue")

    events = sorted(read_list("events.json"), key=lambda e: str(e.get("at")), reverse=True)
    for e in events:
        e["node"] = event_node(e.get("path") or e.get("file") or "", net)
        e["id"] = (
            e.get("id")
            or hashlib.sha1(f"{e.get('at')}{e.get('path') or e.get('file')}".encode()).hexdigest()[
                :10
            ]
        )
    status = read_json("status.json", {})
    last_drop = parse_ts((events[0].get("at") if events else None)) or newest_mtime(root)
    last_check = parse_ts(status.get("last_check_at")) or last_drop
    since = cur.replace(hour=6, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    if cur < since:
        since -= timedelta(days=1)
    read_n = (
        status.get("files_read_since_06")
        if isinstance(status.get("files_read_since_06"), int)
        else sum(1 for e in events if (parse_ts(e.get("at")) or since) >= since)
    )

    inbox = [c for c in open_cards if not c["routed_to_other"]]
    clock = launch_clock.load(root, tz())
    strip = build_strip(cards, root, clock, cur)
    return {
        "now": cur.isoformat(),
        "viewer": viewer_name(root),
        "portal_found": root is not None,
        "map": {
            "nodes": list((net["nodes"] or {}).values()),
            "legs": net["legs"],
            "version": hashlib.sha1(
                json.dumps([net["nodes"], net["legs"]], sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()
            ).hexdigest()[:8],
        },
        "route_level": route_level,
        "badges": dict(badges),
        "shipments": list(ships.values()),
        "strip": strip,
        "clock": build_clock(strip, clock, cur),
        "launch": launch_view.build(cards, net["shipments_raw"], clock, cur, strip),
        "cards": cards,
        "inbox_ids": [c["id"] for c in inbox],
        "calm": not inbox,
        "events": events[:20],
        "activity": build_activity(cards, events, root),
        "last_drop_at": last_drop.isoformat() if last_drop else None,
        "last_check_at": last_check.isoformat() if last_check else None,
        "read_since_6": read_n,
        "trust": read_json("trust.json", {}),
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- app


app = FastAPI(title="ask-soony")


@app.get("/api/state")
def get_inbox_state() -> dict:
    return build_state()


def _card(card_id: str) -> dict:
    for c in build_state()["cards"]:
        if c["id"] == card_id:
            return c
    raise HTTPException(404, "unknown card")


def _record(card_id: str, status: str, action: dict) -> dict:
    stamp = now().isoformat()
    with _lock:
        actions = read_list("actions.json")
        action = {"id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:10], "decision_id": card_id, "at": stamp, **action}
        actions.append(action)
        write_json("actions.json", actions)
        sts = read_json("decision_status.json", {})
        sts[card_id] = {
            "status": status,
            "at": stamp,
            "note": action.get("note"),
            "action_id": action["id"],
        }
        write_json("decision_status.json", sts)
    return action


@app.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/approve")
def approve(card_id: str, body: dict = Body(default_factory=dict)) -> dict:
    card = _card(card_id)
    idx = int(body.get("option", 0))
    if idx >= len(card["options"]):
        raise HTTPException(400, "unknown option")
    opt = card["options"][idx]
    trust = read_json("trust.json", {})
    # Same send path for the Approve button and a spoken yes (alert agent, cardtools.deliver):
    # an email option to a known supplier address goes out now; anything else is only recorded.
    from ask_soony.cardtools import deliver

    sent = deliver(card, opt, body.get("text"))
    status = "sent" if sent else "approved"
    action = _record(
        card_id,
        status,
        {
            "kind": "approve",
            "option": idx,
            "action": opt["action"],
            "channel": opt.get("channel"),
            "to": opt.get("to"),
            "draft": body.get("text") or opt.get("draft"),
            "edited": bool(body.get("text") and body.get("text") != opt.get("draft")),
            "trust": "allow_always"
            if trust.get(opt.get("routine_type") or "") == "allow_always"
            else "allow_once",
            "status": status,
            "action_type": opt.get("routine_type"),
            "via": body.get("via") or "inbox",
            **({"message_id": sent["message_id"], "subject": sent["subject"]} if sent else {}),
        },
    )
    offer = (
        opt.get("routine_type")
        if opt.get("routine_type") and opt["routine_type"] not in trust
        else None
    )
    return {"action": action, "offer_trust": offer}


@app.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/escalate")
def escalate(card_id: str, body: dict = Body(default_factory=dict)) -> dict:
    card = _card(card_id)
    note = (body.get("note") or "").strip()
    brief = card["escalation_brief"] + (
        f" Note from {first_name(build_state()['viewer'])}: {note}" if note else ""
    )
    return _record(
        card_id,
        "escalated",
        {
            "kind": "escalate",
            "to": card.get("approver"),
            "brief": brief,
            "note": note,
            "status": "requested",
            "via": body.get("via") or "inbox",
        },
    )


@app.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/dismiss")
def dismiss(card_id: str, body: dict = Body(default_factory=dict)) -> dict:
    _card(card_id)
    return _record(
        card_id,
        "dismissed",
        {
            "kind": "dismiss",
            "note": body.get("note"),
            "status": "dismissed",
            "via": body.get("via") or "inbox",
        },
    )


@app.post("/api/trust")
def set_trust(body: dict = Body(...)) -> dict:
    kind, mode = body.get("action_type"), body.get("mode")
    if not kind or mode not in ("allow_always", "ask"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "action_type and mode (allow_always|ask) required")
    with _lock:
        trust = read_json("trust.json", {})
        trust[kind] = mode
        write_json("trust.json", trust)
    return trust


@app.get("/api/file")
def get_file(path: str):
    """Source documents behind the evidence, served from the portal mirror only."""
    root = portal_root()
    if root is None:
        raise HTTPException(404)
    target = (root / path).resolve()
    if not target.is_file() or root.resolve() not in target.parents:
        raise HTTPException(404)
    return FileResponse(target)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Jonas: alert agent in one server
# Voice, push, card tools, supplier replies and call webhooks are routers from the alert agent. They
# read verifier-shaped cards through `api.get_state()` and the helpers below, which live in
# globe_api (his original dashboard API); importing it also starts his opt-in background loops
# (ASK_BACKGROUND=on, ASK_REPLY_POLL=on). The inbox's own state stays at /api/state.

    anchors,
    calls,
    cardtools,
    datacheck,
    globe_api,
    push,
    replies,

    teams,
    voice,
)
from ask_soony.basic_auth import BasicAuth  # noqa: E402
from ask_soony.globe_api import (  # noqa: E402,F401  used by the routers as api.<name>
    ROOT,
    _action_status,
    _add_event,
    _now,
    _read,
    _state_dir,
    _write,
)

get_state = globe_api.get_state
for _router in (
    voice.router,
    push.router,
    cardtools.router,
    replies.router,
    calls.router,
    anchors.router,
    teams.router,
    routines.router,
    datacheck.router,
):
    app.include_router(_router)
_GLOBE_ROUTES = {"/api/feed", "/api/network", "/api/mode", "/api/cards/{card_id}/action"}
app.router.routes.extend(
    r for r in globe_api.app.router.routes if getattr(r, "path", None) in _GLOBE_ROUTES
)
app.add_middleware(BasicAuth)


def mount_frontend() -> None:
    dist = Path(os.environ.get("ASK_WEB_DIST", "web/dist"))
    if not dist.is_dir():
        return
    app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=dist / "assets"), name="assets")

    @app.get("/{full_path:path}")
    def spa(full_path: str):
        if full_path.startswith("api/"):
            raise HTTPException(404)
        f = (dist / full_path).resolve()
        if full_path and f.is_file() and dist.resolve() in f.parents:
            return FileResponse(f)
        return FileResponse(dist / "index.html")

time. It writes a small Python routine from a fixed set of building blocks, which runs in the

  replied_cards() -> list[dict]      sent decisions with a reply: reply, reply_date, ...
  silent_shipments() -> list[dict]   shipments with hours since their last update
  carry_out(card_id, option_index, reason) -> dict   approve an option (sends its email if any)
  chase(card_id, message) -> dict    one follow-up in the same email thread to the same supplier
  ask_status(shipment_id, message) -> dict   ask the shipment's supplier for its status
  call(text, card_id) -> dict        phone the responsible person (alert/escalation path)
  notify(text, card_id) -> None      push and Teams
  log(text) -> None                  a line in the run record
  first_time(key) -> bool            True once per key per routine (avoid repeating yourself)
  now() -> str                       current time, ISO 8601
